topic.title: Adjacent Word Edits
topic.shortdesc: A and B edit different words of the same sentence. Only the case where they edit the same word is a real conflict.

section.title: Overview
section.p: The Authentication Service validates the user credentials and issues short-lived access tokens for every request.
Restart each service instance after every configuration change.
Set auth.signing.key to the path of the PEM key file.
Requests are never pinned to an instance. The service is stateless.
